image_description: The image displays two Cavalier King Charles Spaniels standing on a wooden deck. The dog in the foreground is a Blenheim (chestnut and white) spaniel, facing slightly left with large dark eyes and long feathered ears. Behind it stands a Tricolor (black, white, and tan) spaniel wearing a blue harness. The background includes red structural elements and shadows.
